tvShow.name: Tell Me Lies
tvShow.overview: When Lucy Albright and Stephen DeMarco meet at college, they are at that formative age when seemingly mundane choices lead the way to irrevocable consequences. They quickly fall into an addictive entanglement that will permanently alter not only their lives, but the lives of everyone around them.

episodes.name: Lightning Strikes
episodes.overview: Lucy starts her freshman year at Baird College, where an unexpected turn of events during Welcome Week flips her life upside down.

episodes.name: Hot-Blooded
episodes.overview: Lucy struggles with the aftermath of Welcome Week and goes on her first date with Stephen.

episodes.name: We Don't Touch, We Collide
episodes.overview: Pressure on Wrigley intensifies, bleeding into his relationship with Pippa. Lucy and Stephen discuss exclusivity.

episodes.name: Take Off Your Pants and Jacket
episodes.overview: Bree attempts to lose her virginity. Stephen goes to New York City for the weekend, while Lucy tries to figure out where their relationship stands.

episodes.name: Merry F*cking Christmas
episodes.overview: Lucy and Stephen go home for winter break and deal with family tension. Meanwhile, Lucy uncovers a secret.

episodes.name: And I'm Sorry If I Dissed You
episodes.overview: Lucy confronts Stephen about what she found at Macy's memorial.

episodes.name: Castle on a Cloud
episodes.overview: The group goes to Evan's lake house to celebrate his 21st birthday.

episodes.name: Don't Go Wasting Your Emotion
episodes.overview: Pippa has complicated feelings after Wrigley meets her dad. Lucy makes a decision to protect Stephen.

episodes.name: Sugar, We're Going Down Swinging
episodes.overview: Things between Wrigley and Drew come to a head. Lucy is forced to confront her past.

episodes.name: Bedrooms of Our Friends
episodes.overview: Lucy and Stephen go to the final party of the semester and everything changes.

episodes.name: You Got a Reaction, Didn't You?
episodes.overview: Lucy's back at Baird College for sophomore year, ready to start fresh and leave past mistakes behind her.

episodes.name: I Shall Now Perform a 180 Flip-Flop
episodes.overview: Bree's birthday takes an unexpected turn. Lucy's excited to focus on someone new.

episodes.name: I Can See Right Through Myself
episodes.overview: Stephen baits Lucy as she attempts to rid herself of him once and for all. Wrigley and Pippa finally talk.

episodes.name: Just Stable Children
episodes.overview: As the LSAT looms, Stephen's anxiety grows. Wrigley and Evan have a guy's night out.

episodes.name: Evil, Ornery, Scandalous, and Evil
episodes.overview: Lydia and Stephen's sister, Sadie, both visit campus for Halloween. Lucy and Pippa learn something unsettling.

episodes.name: Do Your Dirty Words Come Out to Play?
episodes.overview: When a snowed-in campus forces everyone to Evan's for Thanksgiving, tensions run high.

episodes.name: I'm Not Drowning Fast Enough
episodes.overview: Lucy and Bree attend a professor's Christmas party. Lucy makes a rash decision that affects Pippa.

episodes.name: Don't Struggle Like That, or I Will Only Love You More
episodes.overview: End of semester Christmas celebrations change everything for everyone – again.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Lucy Albright and Stephen DeMarco return to college, not speaking after their dramatic breakup at the start of the summer. Yet while very much at odds, they find themselves in a new version of their addictive dynamic - which is as infuriating as it is inescapable.

episodes.name: You F*cked It, Friend
episodes.overview: Back at Baird College for spring semester, Lucy and Stephen promise things will be different this time.

episodes.name: We Can't Help It If We Are a Problem
episodes.overview: Bree encounters an unexpected reunion. Stephen gives Lucy an ultimatum.

episodes.name: Repent
episodes.overview: The Puswas attend an Apres-Ski frat party. Lucy tries to switch her focus away from Stephen.

episodes.name: Fix Me Up, Girl
episodes.overview: A surprising setback sends Diana back into Stephen's orbit. Lucy seeks advice from an unlikely person.

episodes.name: I'd Like to Hold Her Head Under Water
episodes.overview: Gossip spirals around Lucy at a pool party. Bree seeks answers from her childhood.

episodes.name: I Don't Cry When I'm Sad Anymore
episodes.overview: Everyone goes goth for Valentine’s Day. Stephen introduces a new friend.

episodes.name: I Will Promise Not to Sting
episodes.overview: Relationships are tested at Bree's photography exhibition. Lucy devises a plan to finally put rumors to rest.

episodes.name: Are You Happy Now, That I'm on My Knees?
episodes.overview: A scandal erupts at Baird College. When shocking truths come to light, consequences follow for everyone.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Lucy Albright and Stephen DeMarco have rekindled their tumultuous romance in time for spring semester at Baird College. While they promise things will be different this time, past indiscretions hinder their best intentions, and Lucy finds herself embroiled in a controversy she wants nothing to do with. Meanwhile, the disastrous repercussions from the previous year also force Lucy and Stephen's friends to face their own destructive behaviors. As scandalous secrets fester around campus, vicious consequences threaten Lucy and everyone in her circle.
